object_description: three-part building composition forming a motorway-side spine and central entrance cluster
design_condition: The composition is set parallel to the motorway to close the industrial edge and preserve a large flowing northern landscape, while a rear pedestrian route anticipates future site development.

positive.statement: The clear setting along the motorway preserves and strengthens the landscape flowing to the north.

position.rationale: Northern open landscape is assigned beyond the three offset masses, opposite the motorway-side building spine.

positive.statement: The pedestrian connection convincingly anticipates integration into future site development.

position.rationale: Rear circulation is approximated along the northern edge behind the offset building elements.

positive.statement: The three building types are well proportioned and lie naturally and quietly in the landscape.

position.rationale: Top and elevation views show three distinct, parallel, offset building masses at related levels.

positive.statement: The functional building arrangement is simple and pragmatic.

position.rationale: The overall arrangement is anchored across the visible linear composition and its separated functional volumes.

positive.statement: The internal organization is functional and practical for the processes.

position.rationale: Interior organization is not directly visible, so it is constrained to the central building surface.

positive.statement: The workplace placement responds to motorway noise and creates good lighting conditions.

position.rationale: Workplaces are approximated on the motorway-facing south side at a middle occupied level.

positive.statement: The structural proposal largely does justice to the principles of building over ruins.

position.rationale: Structure is assigned to the visible building footprint and lower sampled mass, consistent with building-over-ruins judgment.

positive.statement: The project impresses with its attitude toward the location and clear urban setting.

position.rationale: The location judgment is anchored to the building spine’s site edge and its broader urban-facing setting.

negative.statement: The spatial and functional relationships between the buildings cannot be clearly differentiated.

position.rationale: The marker spans the three separated masses whose connections and functional distinctions are being judged.

negative.statement: If only the first stage is realized, the volume stands somewhat randomly in the landscape.

position.rationale: A first-stage condition is approximated at the western isolated volume within the linear composition.

negative.statement: The chosen architectural concept and facade cladding are not convincing for the task.

position.rationale: Facade criticism is anchored to the exposed outer surfaces of the eastern building element.

negative.statement: The high originality of the urban-planning concept is not continued in architecture appropriate to the task.

position.rationale: Architectural expression is assessed across the visible building composition rather than one isolated element.
